title: Isometric embedding of a normed field into its complete field
statement: Let $A$ be a normed field, meaning a field [def-weil-field] with a multiplicative real-valued absolute value and its metric $d(a,b)=|a-b|$. Its uniform completion $\widehat A$ is a complete normed field, and the canonical map $\iota:A\to\widehat A$ is a ring homomorphism and an isometry, hence an injective continuous field homomorphism. No completeness assumption on $A$ is imposed.
